subject.title: fix: iOS reconnects stop requesting approval after capability loss

question: Should this protected Gateway fix land with the current Blacksmith Testbox WebSocket pairing proof, or wait for a physical iPhone LAN/VPN reconnect proof first?
rationale: The code path and regression tests support the server-side invariant, but the original report was a real iPhone reconnect loop and the PR explicitly lacks physical-device proof.

options.title: Accept Gateway proof
options.body: Land with the current Testbox WebSocket pairing/reconnect proof because the patch changes only Gateway reconciliation and keeps authority increases gated by approval.

options.title: Require iPhone proof
options.body: Hold landing until a redacted physical iPhone LAN/VPN reconnect run shows approval is not requested after watch or permission loss.
